title: Cigmod
description: This mode is all about cigarettes
body:
**Grow tobacco, roll cigarettes, and trade with the local cigarette vendor (Jožko) — all in Minecraft 1.21.1**

CigMod adds a small but functional tobacco and cigarette system to your world. Farm tobacco plants, dry the leaves, and get your hands on a variety of cigarettes — each with their own unique effects. A custom **Cigarette Vendor** villager even moves into villages, ready to trade.

---

## 🌿 Farming & Crafting

Start by finding **Tobacco Seeds** and planting them like any other crop. Once grown, harvest **Tobacco Leaves** and dry them into **Dried Tobacco Leaves** — though eating them raw is not recommended (gives you Poison).

---

## 🚬 Cigarettes

Each cigarette is a single-use item. Hold right-click to smoke — you need to hold it for at least **3 seconds** for the effects to kick in.

| Item | Effects |
|------|---------|
| **Base Cigarette** | Minor saturation, no special effects |
| **Caramul Yellow** | Luck V (37s) + Hunger XVII (20s) |
| **Caramul Blue** | Speed V (37s) + Nausea IV (18s) |
| **MaroBro Red** | Haste XI (60s) — the long one |
| **MaroBro Red Short** | Haste VI (30s) — quick boost |
| **Golden Cigarette** ✨ | Regen IX, Absorption IV, Fire Resistance III, Water Breathing, Jump Boost III, Saturation VI, Glowing + brief Blindness on use |
| **Wooden Pipe** | Slowness I + Night Vision II + Hero of the Village I (20 durability uses) |

The **Golden Cigarette** has an enchantment glint and is the rarest, most powerful item in the mod. The **Wooden Pipe** is reusable with 20 charges — it slows you down, but gives you a discount with villagers.

---

## 🀄 Cigarette Packs

Most cigarettes come in **packs** that you can open to get individual cigarettes:

- Base Cigarette Pack
- Caramul Yellow Pack
- Caramul Blue Pack
- MaroBro Red Pack
- MaroBro Red Short Pack

---

## 🏘️ The Cigarette Vendor

A new **Cigarette Vendor** villager spawns in villages, complete with a custom house and a **Cigarette Vendor Table** workstation. Trade with them to get packs and cigarettes without having to farm everything yourself.

---

## 📖 Recipes

Crafting recipes are included for the following items:

- Base Cigarette
- Golden Cigarette
- Dried Tobacco Leaf
- Cigarette Vendor Table
- Empty Wooden Pipe
- Wooden Pipe

---

*This mod is intended for players who enjoy vanilla+ additions and small-scale economy/farming mods. Content is fictional and purely gameplay-focused.*
